research_question: After reconstructing the historical nuclear-test/UAP/transient analysis as faithfully as public data allow, does any association remain after observation-opportunity normalization, matched controls, source-quality controls, reporting-policy controls, and frozen null models?
primary_firewall: NO CLAIM ABOUT MULTIPLE UNIVERSES MAY BE PROMOTED WITHOUT AN INDEPENDENT QUANTUM OBSERVABLE

freeze_items: historical input tables and exact hashes
historical analysis code or closest executable reconstruction
UAP report source and deduplication rules

representation_contract.target_invariant: event-rate association after conditioning on observation/reporting opportunity
must_not_conflate: one event represented by multiple reports with multiple independent events

phase_0_recovery.goal: Recover the strongest available version of the historical data and code before any corrective analysis.
tasks: Recover or reconstruct the original 1949-1957 daily master table used for the published POSS-I nuclear/UAP association.
Recover exact transient candidate table and plate/exposure metadata where available.
Recover exact above-ground nuclear-test calendar used by the historical analysis.
Recover exact UAP-report daily counts/source used by the historical analysis, including deduplication rules.
Recover original analysis code; if unavailable, reconstruct the published statistical specification line-by-line and mark deviations.
Hash every recovered input and preserve unavailable bytes as BLOCKED rather than substituting silently.
phase_0_recovery.success_condition: Historical result can be reproduced within declared numerical tolerance or every irreducible reconstruction gap is explicitly identified.

phase_1_exact_replay.goal: Reproduce the old result without correction first.
primary_targets: RR approximately 1.45 for transient presence within +/-1 day of nuclear testing as reported in the 2025 paper
reported p-value approximately 0.008 for the binary association
reported 8.5% increase in transient count per additional UAP report on transient-positive days
phase_1_exact_replay.rule: Failure to reproduce the historical result stops causal reinterpretation and triggers a reconstruction discrepancy audit.

phase_2_observation_opportunity_normaliz.goal: Separate physical-event rate from whether Palomar was observing and from how much it observed.
models: calendar-day model with explicit observed-night indicator
observed-night-only rate model with exposure opportunity offset
lunar illumination and geomagnetic covariates where available
phase_2_observation_opportunity_normaliz.primary_question: Does the nuclear coefficient remain positive and stable after conditioning on actual observation opportunity?

tasks: Astrometric and morphology validation on frozen random samples.
Do not remove suspicious records based on knowledge of nuclear dates.
Compare original author dataset, critique/vetted subset, and JANUS open reconstruction as separate representations rather than pooling them.
Exact-date Project Blue Book/NARA-linked test using frozen morphology labels.
Non-nuclear high-reporting positive-control epochs such as July 1952.
Matched pseudo-test date nulls blocked by year/month.
Separate human-report channel from photographic channel until both independently pass.
phase_4_human_report_controls.shared_trigger_gate: No common physical trigger is admitted unless both channels independently survive their own frozen nulls.

phase_5_modern_nuclear_site_baseline.purpose: Estimate how many modern nuclear-site aerial incidents are attributable to UAS/security/reporting processes rather than residual UAP.
phase_5_modern_nuclear_site_baseline.rule: Raw post-policy report counts cannot be compared directly with earlier counts.

branches.name: FRANCE_GEIPAN
branches.goal: Re-test the published nuclear-risk-site covariate using updated GEIPAN data with population, sky-view, airport/air-traffic, military, moisture/weather and reporting-opportunity controls.

branches.name: US_ATOMIC_COMPLEX_SCU
branches.goal: Reanalyse the open 590-event atomic-complex corpus with matched high-security non-nuclear controls, archival/reporting completeness, site operational dates, media intensity and observation opportunity.

null_models: calendar circular shifts preserving nuclear-event spacing
negative-control morphologies and negative-control time windows

primary_endpoint.name: RESIDUAL_NUCLEAR_ASSOCIATION_AFTER_OPPORTUNITY_NORMALIZATION
primary_endpoint.admission_rule: A positive effect must survive the frozen primary model, predeclared matched/null controls, multiplicity handling, and source-quality sensitivity without changing window, dataset or covariates after seeing the result.

required_before_opening: an independently measurable quantum observable tied prospectively to the hypothesized mechanism
a quantitative prediction distinguishing branching/retrocausal hypothesis from conventional alternatives
a causal model that cannot be reduced to observation/reporting artifacts

planned_outputs: immutable source manifest with SHA-256 hashes
analysis-of-analysis preserving all nulls, failures and unresolved branches
canonical_seal: FIRST REPRODUCE THE OLD SIGNAL. THEN TRY TO KILL IT WITH THE OBSERVATION SCHEDULE, MATCHED CONTROLS, DATA-QUALITY CHECKS, REPORTING POLICY, AND FROZEN NULLS. IF A RESIDUAL SURVIVES, CALL IT A RESIDUAL ASSOCIATION — NOT A UNIVERSE — UNTIL AN INDEPENDENT QUANTUM OBSERVABLE EXISTS.
